name: [Portal] Webinars data model (DB)
description:
### Summary

The contract's `webinars` resource group (`/webinars`, `/webinars/{slug}`) needs a two-level category tree — a parent category's listing/count includes its children, unique among the three taxonomies — and webinar posts that reference an external video (YouTube/Vimeo) rather than hosted video. Nothing exists for this in `st_crm`.

### Why?

Webinars are a distinct content type on partneri.shoptet.cz with no equivalent anywhere in cms4 today; `grep -ri webinar` across the monorepo returns nothing.

### What?

A `partner_webinar` table, a self-referencing two-level `partner_webinar_category` + `_lng` pair, and the join table between them.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `partner_webinar_category` (`id`, `parentId` nullable self-FK) + `partner_webinar_category_lng` (`name`, `title`, `slug` unique per language, `description`, `iconSlug`)
- [ ] `partner_webinar_category_rel` (many-to-many, `webinarId` × `categoryId`)
- [ ] `partner_webinar` (`id`, `slug` unique, `title`, `date`, `externalIdSource` enum(youtube,vimeo), `externalId`, `imageUrl` nullable, `duration` nullable seconds, `content` nullable text)
- [ ] Migration under `migrations/2026/devrel/crm/CZ3TDR1-673/`, `make lint-migrations` passes

### Open questions

- `Webinar.relatedAddons`/`.relatedBlogPosts` likely source from existing marketplace/blog data rather than new tables here — confirm with the webinars domain-layer task filed alongside this one before assuming a join table is needed.

### Resources

- Epic: CZ3TDR1-614
